reply.text: Knee pain or symptoms are one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't weigh in on what the creaking means. Once they've cleared it, I'll train around whatever they say to avoid. For today, I can help you keep the session lighter on legs in a way that is about training, not diagnosis, so tell me what you were planning and I'll look at it with you. Or just say what you want to avoid, and I'll build around that.
